waves.name: Nightly batch cycle
waves.rationale: The only entry point is MAINJOB, whose single step runs PGMMAIN, which calls PGMLIVE. The tree holds no dataset, DB2, IMS or MQ access, so nothing is shared with any other entry point. One wave describes the whole system. Because it is also the must-not-break item, the wave needs a real oracle from job output before it moves.
waves.unblocks: Nothing further inside this tree. It is the whole system, so it unblocks the retirement of the legacy runtime.

unassigned.reason: No static path from any entry point and no reachable computed call in the tree. Not ported. Confirm with the client before deleting.
